Your AI model runs, but the output is wrong. Antoni Viros i Martin explains how hidden synchronization and graph breaks can quietly slow AI training and reduce compiler optimizations. Learn a practical debugging mindset for improving AI model performance in PyTorch and compiled workloads.

00:48 - The .item() Problem: Python Scalar Reads
01:12 - How Graph Breaks Fragment Optimized Regions
01:56 - Synchronization: When Python Forces the Chip to Wait
02:55 - The Real Performance Penalty: Empty Accelerator Queues
03:03 - How to Avoid These Slowdowns in Compiled Models
